name: Low-to-High Cable Woodchop
steps: Set a handle on a low pulley and stand side-on, feet shoulder width.
Bend your knees and hold the handle with both hands beside the near knee.
Breathe out and lift the handle diagonally up across your body.
Finish with arms above the far shoulder as you stand tall.
Lower slowly back down; switch sides after the set.
cues: Arms long, turn from the trunk
Push through the legs as you rise

common_mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back to reach the handle
common_mistakes.fix: Bend the knees and keep the chest up
Keep the arms long and turn the shoulders
